pr.title: feat(run): run in a scratch worktree by default, with --no-worktree to opt out
pr.body: `run` now executes in a throwaway detached worktree under `.git`, so your own checkout never moves: uncommitted work is no longer a blocker, HEAD stays put, and nothing retriggers the file watchers and rebuilds in the directory you are sitting in. **Behavior change worth review:** a fresh worktree has no untracked build output - no `node_modules`, no `target/` - so a command that depends on those may fail there having passed in your checkout. `--no-worktree` restores the old path (and keeps its clean-tree requirement). A crashed run's orphan is reclaimed by the next run rather than via a signal handler, mirroring how `Lock` handles staleness.
